verdict.rationale: HMRC documents a sanctioned agent rail: "If you use an agent, they can sign you up instead." It also notes that agents have their own sign-up path and client-authorisation request links, and that filing runs through approved MTD-compatible software providers. However, this is shown only for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax (sole traders and landlords), not for acting on behalf of a company. Missing for 10: agent authorisation documented for company taxes (Corporation Tax, VAT, PAYE), detail on the scope and permissions of the agent-authorisation process, a published list of authorised agents or providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
